name: Grade 7 IIIT Practice: October Week 6 - Blog Media
description: Practice words for blog posts and media layout.

words.definition: A web page or post that shares ideas or information.
words.example: The blog post explained how to use devices safely.

words.definition: A title for a section of text.
words.example: The heading named the main section of the post.

words.definition: Short text that explains an image.
words.example: The caption described the image under the paragraph.

words.definition: A group of sentences about one idea.
words.example: The paragraph explained one idea with supporting details.

words.definition: How text and images are arranged.
words.example: The layout placed the image next to the safety tip.

words.definition: Words that ask the reader to do something.
words.example: The call to action asked readers to protect their passwords.

words.definition: A note that says who made or provided something.
words.example: The credit named the creator of the image.
